negative_reviews.author: Yeet
negative_reviews.text: Atmosphere is nice along with the general look and vibe of the restaurant however I was really disappointed at how bad and stingy they were over the steak tataki. For £17.50 I got 3 thinly sliced pieces of steak which is a joke, my friend ordered a seafood hell which had a good amount of fish but the amount of noodles in the ramen is a lot compared to everything else , half an egg alongside the steak shows how cheap they are despite the prices . Wouldn’t go again

negative_reviews.author: Rosie Brook
negative_reviews.text: staff were lovely, but the food was not. I’ve had stomach problems for days now. Wouldn’t recommend!
